title: Cache Android platform-tools in Docker toolchain
changes: Install Android platform-tools in their own cached BuildKit toolchain layer, so application source changes no longer trigger a Gradle download. Record their installed revision in BUILD-INFO.txt.
validation: Two ARM64 Docker builds and Kotlin tests passed in android-sdk-cache-v9w2gki7; after a disposable source change, the platform-tools layer was cached and Gradle did not download it. Installed platform-tools revision 37.0.1.
Seven Android Docker launcher tests passed in android-sdk-launcher-qtg8r9k_.
limitations: A fresh builder or removal of the BuildKit cache requires the SDK packages to be downloaded again; no Windows Docker Desktop run was performed.
